stem: For A(−3, 2), plot the point P symmetric to A with respect to the $x$-axis.
solution: Symmetric about the x-axis: change the sign of the y-coordinate.

hints.text: Reflecting in the x-axis changes only one coordinate's sign; the other stays.
The first number is across (x), the second is up (y).
Reflection keeps the distances from the axes; only a sign changes.
